decisions.what: Added theme-color (#2d5016) meta and apple-touch-icon link; marked 'Karibu' with lang="sw"; added role="list" to class-styled lists; removed redundant aria-labelledby on the map figure; gave the email CTA a descriptive aria-label
decisions.why: Spec asks for missing meta tags, lang on non-English text and ARIA where semantics are insufficient (Safari drops list semantics when list-style is none). Existing alt text, heading order and skip link already met the spec

decisions.what: Moved the hero picture/img inline styles into .hero-media rules in styles.css
decisions.why: HTML cleanup; keeps presentation in the stylesheet

decisions.what: Focus ring changed to --color-primary on light backgrounds, with a new --color-secondary-light (#f8c471) for hero/footer; hero eyebrow and footer link hover use the light tint; hero overlay raised from 0.25 to 0.45
decisions.why: Orange #e67e22 failed 3:1 for focus rings on white and 4.5:1 for small text on the dark footer/hero

decisions.what: Removed unused .hours-list selectors and text-badge properties on .logo-mark (now an img); replaced tel:/mailto: attribute selectors with .contact-list a
Dropped !important in print where cascade order is enough; kept it on universal print colour reset, reduced-motion overrides, and the new rule that forces JS-hidden sections visible in print
decisions.why: Those overrides cannot win otherwise (universal selector / inline styles)
The site uses a system font stack with no @font-face, so there is nothing to swap

decisions.what: app.js: per-feature safeInit try/catch with prefixed console.error, delegated smooth-scroll listener, menu document listeners added only while open and removed on close, observers disconnect once all targets are handled, feature detection (closest fallback, IntersectionObserverEntry, HTMLImageElement, scrollIntoView/focus options), runs immediately if DOM already parsed
decisions.why: Spec asks for error handling, event cleanup, observer disconnect and feature detection; IIFE + strict mode kept so no globals

decisions.what: README Lighthouse and Core Web Vitals figures are labelled as targets, with a blank results log
decisions.why: No browser or Lighthouse was available in this environment, so results could not be measured; inventing scores would be misleading
